evidence_snippets: Image ( 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1 TOA/LC08 044034 20140318' ) . select ( [ 'B2' , 'B3' , 'B4' , 'B5' , 'B6' , 'B7' ] ) Make an Array Image, with a 1-D Array per pixel. array image 1d = image . toArray () Make an Array Image with a 2-D Array per pixel, 6x1. array image 2d = array image 1d . toArray ( 1 ) In this example, note that toArray() converts image to an array image in which each pixel is a 1-D vector, the entries of which correspond to the 6 values at the corresponding positions in the bands of image .
To do that, first convert the multi-band Landsat image into an “Array Image”, where each pixel is an Array of band values.
Array images can be created from multi-band images, where each pixel is an array of band values.
